breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect instruction to use a single algebraic-sum internal torque over the full length and explicitly treats the shaft as two segments (0–800 mm and 800–1200 mm) with per-segment internal torque construction. This matches the ground-truth intent of piecewise internal torque.
